R1_EXACT_KEY_RECOVERY.rule: strip exactly one trailing '_<sample_id>' from each ATAC obs_name and require an exact bijection onto the RNA obs_name namespace

S41_DEFECT_IN_MY_FIRST_IMPLEMENTATION.what_I_coded: tested whether atac.obs['barcode'] equals the RNA obs_name namespace directly
S41_DEFECT_IN_MY_FIRST_IMPLEMENTATION.result_of_that_test: 1,501,089 of 1,501,089 unmapped -- i.e. it resolved nothing
S41_DEFECT_IN_MY_FIRST_IMPLEMENTATION.why_it_was_wrong: the ATAC 'barcode' column holds the RAW 10x barcode alone ('CCTATAGCAATATAGG-1'), with no sample qualifier. It was never going to match an RNA obs_name of the form '<barcode>_<SampleID>'. I tested the wrong relation.
S41_DEFECT_IN_MY_FIRST_IMPLEMENTATION.consequence_if_unnoticed: R1b would have been silently recorded as 'unavailable', leaving the pairing resting on R1 alone when a genuine second route existed.
S41_DEFECT_IN_MY_FIRST_IMPLEMENTATION.why_it_did_not_halt_the_run: the stop condition fires only when R1b RESOLVES and then disagrees; a route that resolves nothing is treated as unavailable, not as a contradiction. That was the right behaviour for a broken route but it masked my error.

R1b_SECOND_INDEPENDENT_RECOVERY.CORRECTED_RULE: compose barcode + '_' + sample_id and map onto the RNA obs_name namespace
R1b_SECOND_INDEPENDENT_RECOVERY.why_this_is_genuinely_independent_of_R1: R1 reads only the ATAC obs_name index; R1b reads only the separate 'barcode' and 'sample_id' obs columns. They are derived from different fields and agree on all 1,501,089 nuclei.

C5_BARCODE_COLLISION_AUDIT.interpretation: The raw barcode identifies nothing on its own for 88.01% of nuclei. This quantifies exactly why the sample qualifier is load-bearing and why the canonical receipt refused to treat a bare composite match as evidence.

TAUTOLOGICAL_TRIPWIRES.note: These carry NO evidential weight about nucleus identity. They can reveal a broken join; they cannot confirm a correct one. Reported because a nonzero value would be a stop.

C3_PREDICTION_CONFIRMED_EXACTLY.predicted: exactly 1.000000, because scripts/atac_annotate.py copies the RNA cell_type across atlas_identifier
C3_PREDICTION_CONFIRMED_EXACTLY.subtlety_worth_stating: C-3 is uninformative about whether the depositor's pairing is biologically correct, because the labels are copied. But it IS informative about RECONSTRUCTION FIDELITY: had our reconstructed key differed from the pipeline's atlas_identifier, the copied labels would not have aligned and C-3 would not be exactly 1.0. Those are different questions and only the second is evidence here.

I1_INDEPENDENT_DEPTH_PERMUTATION_WITNESS.why_independent: RNA total_counts is counted from RNA reads; ATAC Unique_nr_frag is counted from ATAC fragment files. Neither is copied across modalities by any inspected scMAVERICS script, unlike cell_type.
I1_INDEPENDENT_DEPTH_PERMUTATION_WITNESS.statistic: within-sample Spearman correlation across nuclei, summarised across samples
I1_INDEPENDENT_DEPTH_PERMUTATION_WITNESS.null: within-sample permutation of barcodes, holding sample identity exactly fixed and destroying only the nucleus-level component of the key
I1_INDEPENDENT_DEPTH_PERMUTATION_WITNESS.separation: the observed value is ~0.49 against a permuted null of essentially zero
I1_INDEPENDENT_DEPTH_PERMUTATION_WITNESS.frozen_interpretation_applied: observed far above the permuted null CORROBORATES nucleus-level alignment
I1_INDEPENDENT_DEPTH_PERMUTATION_WITNESS.what_this_rules_out: a join that is correct only at the SAMPLE level -- the failure mode the canonical receipt warned about -- would have produced the permuted value. It produced 0.49.
